This is what I like about Scematica.

The chart already gave us a ~2.5x move from the recent lows, then crypto did what crypto does — brutal retrace back toward the starting zone.

And honestly? I don't see a problem with that.

What matters to me is what happens while the chart is bleeding.

Scematica is still shipping:

→ Escrow Market v0.0.1 is live and testable
→ Wallet adaptation is being added
→ Archon Wallet partnership + integrations
→ More integrations coming
→ New features being pushed almost daily
→ Dev is still communicating through the problems instead of disappearing
There are clearly issues around the project right now. The dev has also been dealing with financial pressure and some serious drama/attacks.
But that's exactly when you find out whether a builder is here for the chart or for the product.
The chart can recover later. The builder has to keep building now.
That's why I'm still here.
@scematica 🧠⚡

Not financial advice. Just watching a tiny project evolve in real time.
